title: 19-BCV-018 (REV2) - Adhered masonry veneer-generic engineered details for Part 9 residential buildings

facts.text: Revision 2 recognizes values in an Alberta Masonry Council document on adhered-masonry veneer installations up to 3.05 m above local grade on Part 9 residential units.
The source says Part 9 does not prescribe requirements for this installation and that site-specific Part 4 engineering may otherwise be requested.

The generic document can replace project-specific engineering case by case only when project-specific details appear on permit drawings; installations outside its criteria may need site-specific engineering.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.
